objective: Correct KL release editing protection so opening-only reader sessions do not falsely block editorial manuscript and illustration changes, while verified reader progress, comments and rewards stay immutable.
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: Read live Supabase project yhanxndaqbmuzbdqlblu on 2026-11-07; Chapter 3 was flagged as released despite editing, had one session with ping_count=0 and completed_at NULL, no ledger points, comments or achievements. Function guard inspected before applying migration; protected production source baseline GitHub Main 59fe3df64700465ae3f37726e73a31d07c748042. No Expo artifact fingerprint implied.
chosenApproach: Tightly adjust only kl_admin_unlock_unread_release_v1 to treat ping_count=0 and no completion as an opening-only session while retaining authorization, reward and engagement checks, existing session data, draft reset and audit. Apply one migration and add non-destructive SQL contract regression test.
selectionRationale: kl_read_episode_v1 itself creates a session on opening; existing guard interpreted any session as verified reading and falsely blocked Chapter 3. Preserve all actual activity rather than deleting sessions or disabling the gate.
alternativeApproaches: Delete reader session and reopen chapter: rejected, destructive data-integrity risk.
Allow unguarded edits to published chapters: rejected, would invalidate actual points and reader history.
Disable client-side edit button only: rejected, server still rejects legitimate changes and web/native remain broken.
preserveBehaviors: Only an active system admin can edit released content and media
Any reading with ping_count>0 or completed_at remains protected
Any KL points, achievements or comments remain protected
Every existing session, media row, placement and reward remains intact
No Android OTA, web build or unrelated app schema change
acceptanceChecks: Unreleased chapter remains editable by current workflow
Released chapter with only opening-only sessions can return to draft for real edits
Any verified engagement, points, comments or achievements blocks editorial reopening
Existing session records are retained; unlock is auditable
SQL regression test, scope gate, and live result checks pass
